articles.title: PostgreSQL 19 Released with Online Table Repacking and Query Planning Controls

articles.description: The PostgreSQL Global Development Group released PostgreSQL 19, introducing changes to database maintenance, query planning, replication, and application development. The release focuses on reducing administrative overhead and improving performance, with new tools for reorganizing tables without downtime and controlling query plans. By Robert Krzaczyński

articles.title: Claude Code Has Been Leaking Secrets Through Its "Don't Ask Again" Feature
articles.summary: Agentic security firm Apiiro found that Claude Code has been exposing secrets in public repositories due to how it stores them in local file on developers' machines to implement "Don't Ask Again". The...
articles.description: Agentic security firm Apiiro found that Claude Code has been exposing secrets in public repositories due to how it stores them in local file on developers' machines to implement "Don't Ask Again". The company identified 1,122 secrets in claude/settings.local.json files and another 1,160 in git history, in the shared settings.json, and in agent chat transcripts stored in repos. By Sergio De Simone

articles.title: Google Announces Agent Compute Engine for Secure AI Agent Execution
articles.summary: Google recently announced Agent Compute Engine, a managed service that runs AI agents in isolated microVMs, with checkpointing capabilities to suspend and resume execution environments. The design kee...
articles.description: Google recently announced Agent Compute Engine, a managed service that runs AI agents in isolated microVMs, with checkpointing capabilities to suspend and resume execution environments. The design keeps credentials, API keys, and OAuth refresh tokens outside the agent sandbox, using an external Agent Gateway to authenticate requests and inject the required secrets. By Renato Losio
